title: Who Benefits From Sinus Surgery? Comparing Generative AI and Supervised Machine Learning for Predicting Surgical Outcomes in Chronic Rhinosinusitis

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing confusion matrices, false positive rates, and class recall to measure the tendency of Generative AI models to over-predict surgical success (Class 1) and disproportionately recommend surgery.
Computing permutation feature importance on income and insurance variables to assess the model's dependence on socioeconomic status and monitor for fairness.
Computing permutation feature importance on the race variable to evaluate the model's reliance on racial demographics for surgical outcome predictions.
Computing permutation feature importance on the sex variable to evaluate the model's dependence on patient gender.
Computing permutation feature importance on the age variable to identify its impact on model decisions, noting it as a top predictive driver.
